confirmation_rule: Confirm when the comparison completed-bar close remains inside its paired reference at the same decision time.
deduplication_rule: Deduplicate by context version, paired reference identities, anchor bar close time and direction.
expiry_rule: Expire at the registered New York RTH session close if neither confirmation nor invalidation occurred.
invalidation_rule: Invalidate when both primary and comparison close beyond paired references before confirmation.
start_rule: Start when the primary completed-bar close first exceeds its protected reference by at least one registered tick.
